publication.title: Exploratory search on the top of DBpedia chapters with the discovery hub application

source_reading.scope: Complete short paper: spreading activation, sampling, UI/explanations, multilingual endpoints, demo scenario and conclusion.

adjudication.basis: Discovery Hub implements semantic topic exploration with multi-seed queries, facets, ranked related entities and graph explanations over DBpedia endpoints. The demo paper supplies runtime evidence and asserts a prior user experiment without sufficient protocol/sample detail to extract a participant count.
